author: znq19
description: Speed up KiraAI's processing and replies: it streams as it writes, so the first sentence appears in about a second instead of after the whole answer. Plus auto on-demand thinking — every optimisation is toggleable, self-recovering, and applies live from the WebUI panel.

zh.description: 加快 KiraAI 处理和回复速度，边写边发约一秒就能看到第一句，而不是等整段写完；并自动判断该不该深度思考。所有优化可开可关、失败自动恢复，侧边栏面板里改配置即时生效。

en.description: Speed up KiraAI's processing and replies: it streams as it writes, so the first sentence appears in about a second instead of after the whole answer. Plus auto on-demand thinking — every optimisation is toggleable, self-recovering, and applies live from the WebUI panel.
